data.name: Convert Wikitext to HTML
data.evaluateGuide:
Converts MediaWiki wikitext into HTML for a specified page title, enabling rendered page content for display or processing.
Use for: render wikitext, preview page markup, generate HTML
Not supported: HTML-to-wikitext conversion, page retrieval, page editing

data.name: Convert HTML to Wikitext
data.evaluateGuide:
Converts HTML into MediaWiki wikitext for a specified page title, enabling content to be prepared in wiki markup.
Use for: convert HTML markup, prepare wiki content, migrate formatted text
Not supported: wikitext-to-HTML conversion, page retrieval, page editing

data.name: Retrieve a wiki page by title
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a MediaWiki page by title, allowing an agent to obtain the page resource and its available content representation.
Use for: fetch a wiki page, read page content, inspect page details
Not supported: page editing, markup conversion, full-site search

meta.q: List MediaWiki category members with pagination and fetch parsed article HTML, for the Borderlands Fandom wiki catalogue.
